fullDescription: A luxury e-commerce design system tailored for high-end retail, specifically jewelry or boutique fashion. It features a sophisticated burgundy and gold color palette, high-contrast typography using the Rajdhani heading font, and a mobile-optimized layout. Key elements include a 55/45 split-column hero section, horizontal circular category scrolling, and full-width banners with floating animations. The aesthetic combines traditional elegance with modern mobile UI patterns like fixed bottom navigation and snap-scrolling.

structured.summary: An elegant, mobile-first luxury retail interface utilizing a deep burgundy (#540b0e) and gold (#cfa801) theme. It employs a clean split-section hero, smooth micro-interactions, and a structured product grid to create a high-end shopping experience.

style.description: The style is defined by its 'Royal Traditional' aesthetic. Typography pairings include the geometric Rajdhani for headings (bold, high tracking) and PT Sans for legible body text. The color scheme relies heavily on deep burgundy for backgrounds and gold for accents and highlights. Animations are subtle, featuring a signature 'float-scale' effect for brand imagery and scale-down transitions for tactile buttons.
style.prompt: Create a luxury retail design using a palette of Burgundy (#540b0e), Gold (#cfa801), Dark Gray (#414b56), and Light Gray (#999999). Typography: Headings in 'Rajdhani' (bold, tracking-tight or wide for uppercase), Body in 'PT Sans'. Use rounded corners (xl for cards, full for buttons). Buttons should have an active state scale of 95%. Implement an animation called 'float-scale': 3.5s ease-in-out infinite, moving 0 to -5px translateY and scaling 1 to 1.05. Use subtle gradients for text overlays (e.g., from burgundy/95% to transparent).

layout_and_structure.description: A vertical-scrolling mobile layout with a sticky header and fixed bottom navigation. Features specialized sections like a split-hero, horizontal category tray, full-width feature banner, and a 2-column product grid.

prompts.prompt: Sticky header with padding-top: 56px and padding-bottom: 12px. Centered brand logo: Primary name in Rajdhani bold, 24px, uppercase; Subtitle in 9px gold, tracking-widest. Left side: 44px menu button. Right side: Search and Cart buttons (cart includes a 8px notification dot in burgundy).

A container with no margin. Left side (55% width): Burgundy background (#540b0e), center-justified text, 20px padding. Content: 10px gold tag (all-caps), 24px white heading (1.1 leading), 12px semi-transparent white body text, and a rounded-full gold CTA button. Right side (45% width): Full-height image with object-cover and top alignment.

Horizontal scroll section with `snap-x`. Items are 72px wide. Each item consists of a 72px circular image with a 1px border (#e5e7eb) and 4px padding, followed by 13px medium weight text centered below.

Full-width section with a minimum height of 260px. Background image should use the 'float-scale' animation. Overlay a burgundy gradient from left (95% opacity) to right (transparent). Text content on left: 24px white heading, 20px gold sub-heading, and a 36px white circular arrow button.

Two-column grid with 12px gap. Cards feature a 1:1 aspect ratio light gray (#f5f5f5) image area with a top-right floating heart icon (white background, 32px diameter). Below image: 14px dark gray product name, 16px burgundy price in Rajdhani bold.

Fixed bar with white background and gray-100 top border. Padding-bottom: 34px (safe area). Flex distribution for 4 items. Each item: 24px icon, 10px bold label. Active item color: #540b0e; Inactive: #999999.

special_ui_components.description: Full-bleed banner with parallax-style floating image and high-contrast typography.
special_ui_components.prompt: Build a banner with `overflow-hidden` and `relative` positioning. Inside, an image occupies the full background with `animate-float-scale`. Place a `pointer-events-none` gradient layer on top using `bg-gradient-to-r` from `secondary/95` to `transparent`. Text must include drop-shadow-md for legibility.

special_ui_components.description: Snap-scrolling category navigation with circular framing.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a flex container with `overflow-x-auto` and `no-scrollbar`. Each child is a `snap-start` anchor. Image container: 72x72px, `rounded-full`, 1px gray-200 border, white background. Image inside: `object-cover` and `rounded-full`. Typography below: 13px, `leading-tight`.

structured.special_notes: MUST: Maintain a strict 55/45 ratio for the hero section to balance text and visual weight. MUST: Use the 'mix-blend-multiply' property for product images on light backgrounds to ensure seamless integration. MUST NOT: Add extra horizontal padding to full-width banners. MUST NOT: Use generic sans-serif fonts for headings; Rajdhani is essential for the brand's 'heritage' feel.
